app.name: portami
app.tagline: Your bus, live. Anonymous and collaborative.

home.subtitle: Where are we going today?
home.noNearby: No routes found nearby. Turn on GPS or explore the map.

trip.endConfirm: Are you sure you want to end the trip? We'll stop sharing your location.
trip.endedAuto: We detected you got off. Trip ended automatically.
trip.permissionNeeded: We need GPS access to track your trip

invite.title: Invite {{name}} via another app
invite.subtitle: Generate a link you can send via WhatsApp, Telegram or SMS. When they open it in portami, they'll start receiving your trip.
invite.notSupported: Your browser doesn't support WebRTC; we can't create the link.

connect.title: Receive invitation
connect.subtitle: {{alias}} wants to share their trip with you.
connect.sendBack: Send this answer back to {{alias}} via the same app
connect.answerCopyHint: Copy this link and paste it in your chat with {{alias}}
connect.waitingSubtitle: When they open the return link in portami, the connection completes automatically.
connect.notForYou: This answer is not for you
connect.success: Connected! You'll receive the trip live.

board.title: Board a bus/train
board.noMatch: No matching routes. Is this a new trip?
board.confirm: Is it one of these routes? The closer, the more likely.
board.recordNew: None match — record a new one

eta.title: Estimated time of arrival
eta.disclaimer: Calculated from the bus's current position. This is an estimate — actual arrival may vary with traffic, signals and stops.

record.title: Route name
record.minStops: We need at least 3 detected stops
record.minDistance: Recorded route is too short (minimum 500 m)
record.trimTip: Trim the edges and remove sections that don't belong to the route
record.saveSuccess: Route saved and sent to the server
record.saveOffline: Route saved locally; will sync when online
record.namingHint: Use the name people would use to recognize it

proposal.title: Propose change
proposal.describeTitleHint: E.g.: New stop at Main Square
proposal.yourProposal: You can't vote on your own proposal
proposal.applied: Your proposal was applied to the route
proposal.rejectedNotif: Your proposal was rejected by the community

sync.verifyMatch: Check that the code matches on both devices
sync.codeMismatch: Codes don't match. Pairing aborted for safety.

settings.title: Settings
settings.regenerateWarn: This will invalidate your reputation and disconnect your paired devices.
settings.privacyText: portami does not collect personal data. Your identity is a pair of Ed25519 keys generated on your device. Location is shared only while you have an active trip.
